evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we propose Salience-Aware Reinforced Adaptive decoding (SARA), which incorporates salient information and allows the model to adaptively determine reliance on the source document’s context, salient context, and the model’s prior knowledge based on pointwise mutual information.
Experiments on CNN/DM, WikiHow, and NYT50 datasets show that SARA consistently improves the quality and faithfulness of summaries across various LLM backbones without modifying their weights.
